EXCLUSION TABLE — HO-0304 ed. 03-24

| Code | Excluded Peril                             | Conditions / Scope                                                 |

| E-13 | Sewer or drain backup (off-premises)       | Backup originating from a municipal or shared drain line           |

[HO-0304 ed. 03-24] SECTION-III
SECTION III — CONDITIONS
Claim reporting for water damage under this endorsement must occur within
72 hours of the insured first discovering the loss. Failure to report within
this window may result in denial under E-11 (gradual seepage classification).

[HO-0304 ed. 03-24] CLAUSE-WD-1
CLAUSE WD-1 — SUDDEN AND ACCIDENTAL DISCHARGE
Coverage applies to sudden and accidental discharge or overflow of water or
steam from within a plumbing, heating, air conditioning, or automatic fire
protective sprinkler system, or from within a household appliance. The term
"sudden and accidental" means an event that is abrupt, unintended, and
not the result of continuous seepage or leakage over a period of time exceeding
fourteen (14) consecutive days.

[HO-0308 ed. 05-24] CLAUSE-EM-3
SECTION III — ENSUING LOSS EXCEPTION NOTE
Only ensuing fire (per CLAUSE EM-3) is excepted from this exclusion.
Water damage that ensues from ruptured pipes caused by earth movement
is also excluded under E-31 (concurrent cause rule, CLAUSE EM-2).
